landing.title: Manage your freelance business, hassle-free
landing.subtitle: Salair automates your invoices, payments and tax declarations. For freelancers who want to focus on their work, not on administrative tasks.

features.title: Features
features.heading: An all-in-one tool, designed for freelancers
features.description: Salair structures your freelance activity from your first client. No more Excel files and forgotten tax reminders.

access.title: Manage your clients easily
access.description: Create complete client profiles, view their invoice history and track your relationships effortlessly.

payslips.title: Create invoices in 30 seconds
payslips.description: Generate and send professional compliant invoices, ready to be paid online.

reports.title: Track your payments and income
reports.description: Get paid by transfer or card, automatically remind unpaid invoices, and track your revenue throughout the month.

employees.title: Prepare your tax declarations
employees.description: Salair reminds you of your deadlines and guides you step by step through your monthly or quarterly declarations.

documents.title: Centralize your tax documents
documents.description: Invoices, receipts, statements: everything is organized, archived and ready for audits or accounting.

support.title: Responsive human support
support.description: Have a question about your declarations or invoices? We'll support you from A to Z, without unnecessary jargon.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using Salair, billing, and your subscription.

more_questions.title: Still have questions?
more_questions.subtitle: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Please chat to our friendly team.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes, you can try Salair for free for 30 days. And to help you get started, we offer a personalized 30-minute onboarding call to set up your account and answer all your questions.

change_plan.question: Can I change my plan later?
change_plan.answer: Absolutely! You can modify your subscription at any time from your personal dashboard. Changes take effect immediately, and everything is prorated.

cancellation.question: What's your cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Once cancelled, you'll retain access to all paid features until the end of your current billing period. No automatic renewal will occur after that date.

invoice_info.question: Can I add other information to my invoices?
invoice_info.answer: Yes, you can customize your invoices with the information of your choice: legal notices, payment terms, business ID number, bank details, etc. You can also add a specific message or note for each client.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Billing is either monthly or annual depending on the plan you choose. A detailed summary is available with each renewal, and your subscription invoices can be downloaded at any time from your account.

email_change.question: How do I change my login email address?
email_change.answer: Go to your account settings, under 'Personal Information'. There, you can safely change your login email address. An email verification will be required.
